headline: Four phases connect source-backed evidence with business-owned decisions.
subtitle: Each phase combines an evidence review with a wider-team decision.
phase_1_evidence: Application scope, change drivers, desired outcomes, baseline measures, and open questions.
phase_1_decision: Agree business scope, decision owners, success measures, and investment questions.
phase_2_evidence: Inventory, technology signals, dependencies, interfaces, data use, and evidence confidence.
phase_2_decision: Review current behavior, operating needs, constraints, risk, and cost assumptions.
phase_3_evidence: Validated workflows, target-state options, architecture boundaries, and value hypotheses.
phase_3_decision: Choose what to retain, remove, redesign, automate, buy, or build; test the choices.
phase_4_evidence: Approved findings, dependencies, impact considerations, scenarios, and planning assumptions.
phase_4_decision: Select dispositions, confirm governance, and sequence a feasible first planning horizon.
takeaway: Evidence informs options; client and delivery teams validate the assumptions and own modernization decisions.
